Title: The SAGA Survey. III. A Census of 101 Satellite Systems around 
       Milky Way-mass Galaxies 
Authors: Mao Y.-Y., Geha M., Wechsler R.H., Asali Y., Wang Y., Kado-Fong E., 
         Kallivayalil N., Nadler E.O., Tollerud E.J., Weiner B., 
         de los Reyes M.A.C., Wu J.F. 
Table: Schema of SAGA DR3 Satellite Candidate Catalog 
================================================================================
Byte-by-byte Description of file: datafileC4.txt
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Bytes Format Units         Label       Explanations
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   1- 18 I18    ---           OBJID       Unique galaxy identifier
  20- 28 A9     ---           HOSTID      Unique host identifier, can be used to join the host table
  30- 40 F11.7  deg           RAdeg       Right ascension in decimal degrees (J2000)
  42- 52 F11.7  deg           DEdeg       Declination in decimal degrees (J2000)
  54- 60 F7.3   kpc           Rhost       Projected radial distance of the object to the host
  62- 67 F6.3   mag           rmag        Apparent r-band magnitude, extinction corrected, derived from DESI Legacy Imaging
  69- 74 F6.4   mag         e_rmag        Uncertainty in rmag, derived from DESI Legacy Imaging
  76- 81 F6.3   mag           gr          g-r color, extinction corrected, derived from DESI Legacy Imaging
  83- 88 F6.3   mag           rmag-fiber  Apparent r-band fiber magnitude, 1.5-arcsec diameter, extinction corrected, derived from DESI Legacy Imaging
  90- 95 F6.3   mag/arcsec2   sb          Effective surface brightness, derived from DESI Legacy Imaging
  97-101 F5.3   ---           ba          Galaxy axis ratio, taken from DESI Legacy Imaging
 103-109 F7.3   deg           PA          Galaxy position angle, taken from DESI Legacy Imaging
 111-115 F5.3   ---           Sersic      Galaxy Sersic index, taken from DESI Legacy Imaging
 117-121 F5.3   [solMass]     log(M*)     Log of estimated galaxy stellar mass, if candidate is at the same distance as the host
 123-123 I1     ---           quenched    Star forming or quenched, estimated purely based on its color (1)
 125-129 F5.3   ---           Psat        Probability of being a satellite, based on the incompleteness correction model
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Note (1): 
    0 = star forming;
    1 = quenched.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
